reply_text:
*One merge-blocking finding* in `dedupe-imports` against `main`:

*P1 — Overlapping contacts aren’t deduplicated by ID* — `src/dedupe.js:2`
`new Set(contacts)` compares object identity, not `id`. Separate imports containing `{ id: 1, name: 'Ada' }` and `{ id: 1, name: 'Ada updated' }` retain both contacts. This also breaks `mergeImports` (`src/merge.js:4`) and contradicts the first-seen-per-ID contract in `README.md:5`.

*Recommended fix:* Track seen IDs and retain only the first contact for each ID. Add regression tests using distinct objects with the same ID, both directly and across import lists.

All 4 existing tests pass, but `test/dedupe.test.js` only checks repeated references and distinct IDs. I reproduced the failure in both `dedupe` and `mergeImports`.

No files changed.
